about: A made-up inbox for scoring the email classifier. Every person, company and address is fictional. Gold labels follow the classifier's own definitions (classify.py INSTRUCTIONS). A list of values means any of them is acceptable; event_optional means a calendar entry is neither required nor penalised; urgent null means importance isn't scored for that case. 'evidence' is the text the right answer depends on, so the harness can tell when it was cut off before the model saw it.

cases.subject: Interview with Harbourline
cases.body:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for your interest in Harbourline and for taking the time to apply for the Quality Engineer position. We were impressed by your application and would love to get to know you better.

About Harbourline
Harbourline builds legal technology used by more than 4,000 firms across Australia and New Zealand. Our platform connects lawyers to government registries, automates searches and keeps matters moving. We're a team of 600 people across Sydney, Melbourne and Auckland, and we care about quality as much as speed.

About the interview
This is a technical interview with two members of our Quality Engineering team. It's a conversation, not a test: we'll talk through your experience, then work through a problem similar to the ones the team handles every week. There's no need to prepare slides. Bring a notebook if you like to sketch ideas.

Where
Level 12, 88 Harbour Street, Sydney. When you arrive, wait in the main lobby near the cafe and send us a message, and someone will come down to meet you. There's also a video link below if anything changes on the day.

When
Date: Tuesday 13 October 2026
Time: 11:00am to 12:00pm AEDT

If this time doesn't work, reply to this email and we'll find another.

Best regards,
The Harbourline Talent Team

cases.subject: Next steps for your application
cases.body:
Hello Sam,

Thank you for applying to Northwind Analytics. Every application at Northwind is read by a person, not a filter, and yours stood out to the hiring team for the Test Automation Engineer role. We're excited to move you to the next stage of our process, which has three short steps.

Our process
1. A conversation with the hiring manager about your experience and what you're looking for.
2. A practical session where you pair with one of our engineers on a small automation problem. You won't need to install anything; we'll share a browser-based environment.
3. A final chat with the team about how we work together.

What we're looking for
We value curiosity, clear communication and engineers who care about the people using what we build. We don't expect you to know our stack already. We'd rather hear how you'd approach something new.

Your first conversation
We've booked the first conversation for next Thursday at 10am, on a video call with Daniel Okafor, our Head of Quality. The link will follow in a calendar invite.

We look forward to speaking with you.

Northwind Talent

cases.subject: Update on your Ridgeway application
cases.body:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for your interest in the Automation Test Engineer position at Ridgeway Insurance, and for the time you put into your application. We know how much effort goes into putting yourself forward, and we want to start by saying that we genuinely appreciate it.

We received a very large number of applications for this role from candidates with a wide range of strong backgrounds. Our hiring team reviewed every application carefully against the skills and experience the role needs right now, including the team's current projects and the way the role will grow over the next year.

This was not an easy process, and the standard of applicants was high. We also want to be transparent about how we make these decisions: we look at the full picture of each candidate, and a decision either way is not a judgement of your abilities.

After careful consideration, we've decided not to progress your application further. We'll keep your details on file and may contact you about future roles that match your experience.

We wish you every success in your search.

Ridgeway Talent
